summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 new ProjectDash features: Group Analytics Tab, Bulk Group Actions, and Email Preview. All 13 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend UI flows verified working via Playwright.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - minor accessibility issue

passed_tests: Super Admin Login: Returns is_super_admin=true in user object
Analytics Overview: GET /api/superadmin/analytics/overview returns group analytics with all required fields
Analytics Overview: Requires super admin authentication (401 for unauthenticated)
Analytics Tab UI: Table loads with 25 groups showing users, projects, work logs, invoices, expenses, forms, last activity
Analytics Tab UI: Activity level indicators (high/mid/low) display correctly
Bulk Verify: POST /api/superadmin/groups/bulk-verify verifies multiple groups
Bulk Unverify: POST /api/superadmin/groups/bulk-verify with verified=false unverifies groups
Bulk Disable: POST /api/superadmin/groups/bulk-disable disables multiple groups
Bulk Enable: POST /api/superadmin/groups/bulk-disable with disabled=false enables groups
Bulk Actions: Empty group list returns 400 error
Bulk Actions UI: Select All checkbox selects all 25 groups
Bulk Actions UI: Individual group checkboxes work with selection count
Bulk Actions UI: Bulk action buttons (Verify, Unverify, Disable, Enable, Clear) appear when groups selected
Bulk Actions UI: Toast notifications show success messages (e.g., 'Verified 2 groups')
Bulk Actions UI: Clear button clears selection and hides bulk action bar
Email Preview: GET /api/settings/email/preview?template=invite returns invite HTML
Email Preview: GET /api/settings/email/preview?template=reset returns reset HTML
Email Preview: Requires authentication (401 for unauthenticated)
Email Preview: Default template is 'invite'
Email Preview UI: Invite Email button opens modal with dark-themed template
Email Preview UI: Password Reset button opens modal with lock icon and reset button
Email Preview UI: Tab switching between Invite and Password Reset works
Activity Logs: Bulk actions are logged in admin activity logs
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. All bulk actions (verify/disable) properly restored to original state.
